## Agent Handoff & Pull Request Checklist

> **Per ATOMICA Multi-Agent Protocol (Section 17.7), all contributions must provide a comprehensive handoff report.**

### 1. Agent Identification
- **Contributing Agent:** `agent/claude` | `agent/gemini` | Other:
- **Task ID:** (e.g. `TSK-P0-003`)
- **Target Subsystem:** (e.g. `@atomica/core-chem`, `project-management/research`)

### 2. Summary of Implementation / Research
- [Detailed summary of what was completed]

### 3. Files Created or Modified
- `path/to/file1`
- `path/to/file2`

### 4. Technical & Architectural Decisions
- [Key technical decisions made, referenced in `DECISIONS.md`]

### 5. Dependencies Introduced
- [New libraries, APIs, or schema contracts introduced]

### 6. Tests & Scientific Verification
- [Commands run, tests added, and mathematical verification results]

### 7. Known Limitations & Outstanding Issues
- [Any edge cases, performance constraints, or follow-ups needed]

### 8. Instructions for Reviewing / Next Agent
- [Specific areas requiring review or steps to continue development]

---
- [ ] Task status updated in `project-management/TASK_BOARD.md`
- [ ] Development log updated in `project-management/DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md`
- [ ] Shared contracts verified in `project-management/API_CONTRACTS.md`
- [ ] Phase 0 Rule Respected (No unapproved production implementation code)
